_readme: #454 (slice por) lexical patterns for por_for_eng + por_br_for_eng. Same shape as ../patterns.json. detect.cjs keys patterns by the TARGET language prefix, so 'por' runs on BOTH courses: ep_forms_in_br is only a defect in por_br_for_eng, br_forms_in_ep only in por_for_eng. Every kp is live or pre-fix text and passes calibration.
